### Summary

### Summary

The CHANGELOG at commit `79422c835f214875852bf2b2cb950c44684eb046`
already contains an entry for `0.13.5`, but the latest available GitHub/download
release appears to still be `0.13.4`.

The corresponding release workflow also appears to have been canceled:

- CHANGELOG: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/79422c835f214875852bf2b2cb950c44684eb046/CHANGELOG.md
- Release workflow: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/actions/runs/39535970462

### Expected behavior

Either `0.13.5` should be published, or the CHANGELOG/version state should reflect
the latest actually released version.

### Additional context

This can cause automation that derives the latest version from the repository
state/CHANGELOG to select `0.13.5`, although that version is not available for
download.

Was the `0.13.5` release intentionally canceled?

### Platform

any

### Version

0.13.5

unrelated
